recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is for core. No core follow-up is recommended; publication review should verify that the FHIR Extension Pack continues to publish StructureDefinition/expression-coding.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 request to allow Expression to carry a terminology code for the meaning of its result. The approved modification was a standard extension, expression-coding, with context Expression, cardinality 0..*, value type Coding, and an example LOINC binding rather than a new core Expression.code CodeableConcept element.
initial_application: No core source commit tagged FHIR-42709 was found. FHIR Extension Pack commit 8233f408ef77c0f0b4106742f47fb226f33ca59b added input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-expression-coding.json, with later QA commits ca58d05 and 2b046fd adjusting status and version-specific-use metadata while preserving the requested semantics.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2023-10-23 record the preference for an extension rather than a core Expression element and for Coding rather than CodeableConcept. The May 2024 WGM minutes record final approval, Bryn Rhodes/Anne Smith 36-0-2. The Extension Pack is a separate specification for global extensions and its ImplementationGuide includes input/definitions/*, which covers the expression-coding source file.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The core checkout actively builds Expression but does not define expression-coding; that absence is correct because the requested artifact belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack and is already defined there with the requested canonical URL, Expression context, repeatability, Coding value, and LOINC example binding.
